basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is filling one Administrative Assistant post for 11 months at a total pay of Rs. 44000 in the project "Trans-Path Planning" at the Humanities and Social Sciences Department. The essential qualification is ME in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE). Applications are made online on the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell by 27 November 2026, 5 PM, and the online interview is on 4 December 2026 at 2:00 PM on Webex.

how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/).
Find the position by searching for the project title "Trans-Path Planning".
Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.

Submit before 27 November 2026, 5 PM. The notice also says a scanned copy of the CV giving all educational qualifications, experience, contact address, phone no. and email should be sent by this deadline.

For technical help with the online application, email [email protected]. For any clarification, contact Prof. Anamika Barua (Principal Investigator), email [email protected], phone 0361-258-2563/2580.
Scanned copy of the CV with details of all educational qualifications, experience, contact address, phone no., email, etc.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is an institute in Guwahati, Assam (PIN 781039). This notice is issued by its Research and Development Section for a project post at the Humanities and Social Sciences Department. The notice is signed by the Assistant Registrar (R&D).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience: preference will be given to candidates having a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in a Government Institution. Desirable: Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel, with strong numerical and coordination skills. Experience in monitoring budgets, preparing financial and expenditure reports, maintaining project accounts and handling administrative and financial records.

rows.essential_qualification: ME in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice recommends a pay of Rs. 44000, with HRA and Medical shown as NA, so the total amount is Rs. 44000. The duration of appointment is 11 months. The position includes a probation period of 3 months; based on the performance, the contract will be extended.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Administrative Assistant
content_sections.text: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati ( https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/ ). Find the position by searching for the project title "Trans-Path Planning". Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal. Submit before 27 November 2026, 5 PM. The notice also says a scanned copy of the CV giving all educational qualifications, experience, contact address, phone no. and email should be sent by this deadline. For technical help with the online application, email [email protected] . For any clarification, contact Prof. Anamika Barua (Principal Investigator), email [email protected] , phone 0361-258-2563/2580. Documents named in the notice: Scanned copy of the CV with details of all educational qualifications, experience, contact address, phone no., email, etc.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the online interview, held on 4 December 2026 at 2:00 PM on Webex. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email on 3 December 2026. No call letter will be sent separately.
